verdict.rationale: PayPal offers an official MCP server enabling natural-language control via MCP clients, plus an Agent Toolkit for function-calling integration with agent frameworks like LangChain and OpenAI's Agent SDK, showing genuine agentic support. However, this is aimed at developers/merchants building integrations rather than end-users directly commanding PayPal in natural language, and evidence is vendor-documentation only with no hands-on community validation of the NL experience.
